summary: This directory manages the lifecycle and retrieval of application-wide configuration and runtime parameters. It ensures that settings are accessible in a type-safe manner, accounting for user-specific context and historical state changes throughout the system.
responsibilities: Enable retrieval of parameters based on user context
Support historical lookup of configuration values
relationships: The Parameter Service utilizes user contexts to scope the retrieval of specific application parameters.
Historical lookups allow the system to reconstruct past parameter states for auditing or versioning.
designDecisions: Centralized parameter management via a dedicated service class
Type-safe access patterns for application configuration
